title: Concept: Private IPv4 address in a response
description: A private-range IPv4 address in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The address maps the internal network the application talks to, and combined with an SSRF primitive it becomes a set of targets rather than a guess.
applicability: Debug pages, proxy error messages and client configuration that lists upstream hosts.
risk: An internal address is the first hop of lateral movement and is worthless to a browser.
